title: YOU ARE MY HIDING PLACE

lines.text: Let the weak say, "I am strong,"
In the strength of my God.

chords:
[Verse 1]
[Dm]You are my hiding place,
[Gm]You always fill my heart,
With [C]songs of de[F]liverance,[A]
[Dm]Whenever I am afraid,
[Gm]I will trust in [A][Dm]You,
I will trust in You,
Let the [Gm]weak say, "I am [C]strong,"
In the [F]strength of my [Dm]God.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You are my hiding place,
You always fill my heart,
With songs of deliverance,
Whenever I am afraid,
I will trust in You,
I will trust in You,
Let the weak say, "I am strong,"
In the strength of my God.
